evidence: M-O s.v. football positions: goalkeeper, goalie (Albert)
terms.comment: In the Vulgate a doorkeeper or porter (Lewis & Short); Traupman’s word for the goalkeeper at football and hockey, with the feminine portāria.

evidence: M-O s.v. football positions: goalkeeper, goalie (Egger)
terms.comment: “Guardian of the goal”, in plain classical words.
